An analyst needs an invitation to the training workspace harbor-lab and must sign in with the email address on that invitation. An invitation sent to a different address must be replaced by the workspace coordinator; forwarding it does not change the invited identity. No local client installation is needed. The invitation opens a Join workspace screen; Accept joins harbor-lab with the Reviewer role. Reviewers can read notebooks, create private notes, and submit reviews, but cannot change notebook source cells. The Workspace menu selects harbor-lab. Its Training folder contains the notebook Weekly margin practice. This training notebook has synthetic data and no connection to production datasets. The Overview panel describes the training exercise. Published output displays the author's saved results; opening it does not execute cells. The supplied baseline output shows 18 accounts and a total margin of 4,320 credits. These are the intended comparison values for this exercise, not a calculation the reviewer must run. New note creates a private note visible only to its author, and saving a private note does not submit a review. Review opens the submission form. That form's Summary field must contain text before Submit review is enabled. For the exercise, enter the literal summary 'Baseline checked against the exercise values.' Submit review makes the summary visible to workspace members. A successful submission displays Submitted and a review identifier; the example identifier rv-208 is illustrative and the analyst should record their actual displayed identifier. Send that actual identifier to the workspace coordinator to complete the practice handoff. Submission does not grant editing permissions. If Weekly margin practice is missing from Training, contact the coordinator rather than creating a replacement notebook. A disabled Submit review button should first be checked for an empty Summary field. Keep real customer data out of training notes. Sign out from the account menu when finished on a shared computer.
draft:
# Your first review in Aster Notebook

Use this walkthrough to complete a practice review in Aster Notebook 2.1. You will join the harbor-lab training workspace, inspect a published notebook, and send the workspace coordinator your review identifier. The exercise uses synthetic data and has no connection to production datasets. You do not need to install a local client.

## Before you join

Have your harbor-lab invitation available and sign in with the email address to which it was sent. If the invitation names a different address, ask the workspace coordinator for a replacement. Forwarding the invitation does not change the identity allowed to accept it.

Open the invitation and select **Accept** on the **Join workspace** screen. You join as a **Reviewer**. This role lets you read notebooks, create private notes, and submit reviews; it does not let you change notebook source cells.

## Inspect the exercise

1. Choose **harbor-lab** from the **Workspace** menu.
2. Open the **Training** folder and select **Weekly margin practice**.
3. Read the **Overview** panel for the exercise context.
4. Open **Published output** and compare it with the baseline below.

Published output shows results previously saved by the author. Opening it does not execute the notebook's cells, so this exercise asks you to inspect an existing result rather than run a calculation.

| Baseline item | Expected value |
| --- | --- |
| Accounts | 18 |
| Total margin | 4,320 credits |

If you want a reminder for yourself, use **New note**. A private note is visible only to you. Saving it is separate from submitting a review, and the coordinator cannot use that private note as your completed handoff. Keep real customer data out of training notes.

## Submit and hand off

Open **Review**. In the **Summary** field, enter:

> Baseline checked against the exercise values.

Then select **Submit review**. The summary becomes visible to workspace members. On success, the page displays **Submitted** and a review identifier, such as `rv-208`. Record the identifier actually shown for your submission and send it to the workspace coordinator. That message completes the practice handoff; the sample identifier on this page is only an illustration.

Submitting a review does not change your Reviewer permissions. You can finish this exercise without editing any source cells.

## If you get stuck

If **Weekly margin practice** is missing from **Training**, contact the coordinator instead of creating a replacement. If **Submit review** is disabled, first check that **Summary** contains text. These checks address the missing exercise and incomplete form separately.

When you finish on a shared computer, use the account menu to sign out.
